patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Intercom documents a broader use-case set; Tidio is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose Tidio only if your buying job matches “Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $” rather than Intercom's shape. Choose Intercom only if your buying job matches “Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.9” rather than Tidio's shape. Workflow advantage: Tidio leans shared coverage; Intercom leans customer-messaging, whatsapp-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Intercom documents a broader use-case set; Tidio is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Tidio is Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $49.17. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Intercom is Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.99/outcome. Primary live-chat; BC + CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: Tidio (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Intercom (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Tidio-leaning — vs Intercom-leaning customer-messaging, whatsapp-support, contact-center.
- Researched limits: Tidio — Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers; Intercom — Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume.

Limitations — Tidio: Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers; Not a full helpdesk/ITSM — thin ticketing vs Freshdesk; Intercom: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; SMS, WhatsApp and Phone are pay-as-you-go add-on channels, not unlimited included.

Poor-fit cases: Tidio is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers · Intercom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume · Avoid Tidio if you actually need Intercom's motion (Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
